metadata.disclaimer: These are simulated results on synthetic people. They show what the system measures and are not evidence of clinical effectiveness. All probabilities other than the one published figure are assumptions listed in the parameter table.

measure_definitions.time_to_notification_h: Hours from result issued to patient notified (median, p90), among people who reached it inside the window.
measure_definitions.time_to_acknowledgement_h: Hours from result issued to patient acknowledged (baseline: patient acts on the report).
measure_definitions.time_to_confirmation_d: Days from result issued to clinician review of confirmation (confirmed or not confirmed).
measure_definitions.time_to_consultation_d: Days from result issued to the specialist visit taking place.
measure_definitions.time_to_care_d: Days from result issued to treatment started or surveillance agreed.
measure_definitions.referral_completion_rate: Referral accepted, among people whose raised reading was confirmed.
measure_definitions.appointment_completion_rate: Visit attended, among people with a booked appointment.
measure_definitions.treatment_initiation_rate: Treatment started, among people who attended the visit.
measure_definitions.care_reached_rate: Reached care (step 7) inside the window, among actionable people. Not one of the spec measures; used for the sensitivity analysis.
measure_definitions.unresolved_results: Actionable people not in care and not clinically resolved as not confirmed at the end of the window, with the step where they stopped.
measure_definitions.teach_back_pass_rate: Passed teach-back at the first try, among people who acknowledged. With-loop only.
measure_definitions.patient_confidence_mean: Mean self-rated confidence 1 to 5 among people who acknowledged. With-loop only.
measure_definitions.plan_checkin_rate: Weekly check-ins answered (done or partly) per week offered. With-loop only.
measure_definitions.re_engagement_after_lapse_rate: People with a missed week who answered a check-in in the next two weeks. With-loop only.

reason_labels.no_acknowledgement: Patient did not acknowledge in time
reason_labels.confirmation_not_completed: Confirmation by home or 24-hour monitoring not completed in time
reason_labels.care_not_recorded: Visit outcome not recorded in time

published_sources.simple_bangladesh: Simple app, Bangladesh: overdue lists and calls cut 3-month missed visits from 50% to 26% in six months (team brief)
published_sources.mohap_uae: MOHAP 2025 UAE screening campaign, reported by Gulf News: over 40% of people with hypertension did not know it; 29% of treated patients not at target (team brief). Context only, not used as a transition probability.
published_sources.nhns_uae: UAE National Health and Nutrition Survey 2024 to 2025: 25.9% of UAE adults have high blood pressure (team brief). Context only, not used as a transition probability.
published_sources.tam_jmir_2021: Tam et al., JMIR mHealth 2021: text messaging roughly halved the odds of uncontrolled BP (team brief). Context only, not used as a transition probability.

parameters.name: simulation.follow_up_days
parameters.rationale: Window in which a result must reach care to count as resolved.

parameters.name: simulation.plan_weeks
parameters.rationale: Length of the weekly lifestyle plan window simulated after care starts.

parameters.name: baseline.p_notified
parameters.rationale: A routine result report reaches most people but nobody checks.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_notified
parameters.rationale: A named owner, a due date and a second channel make delivery very likely.

parameters.name: baseline.notify_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Report sent in a batch.

parameters.name: with_loop.notify_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Service level is 24 hours for this step, 2 hours if severe.

parameters.name: baseline.notify_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Wide spread, no tracking.

parameters.name: with_loop.notify_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Narrower spread because the step has a due date.

parameters.name: baseline.p_acknowledged
parameters.rationale: No prompt to respond; about half act.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_acknowledged
parameters.rationale: Reminders at 24, 48 and 72 hours and a coordinator call. Kept well below 100 percent.

parameters.name: baseline.ack_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Self-paced.

parameters.name: with_loop.ack_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Reminder protocol runs inside 72 hours.

parameters.name: baseline.ack_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Wide spread.

parameters.name: with_loop.ack_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Narrower spread.

parameters.name: baseline.p_confirmation_completed
parameters.rationale: No instructions, no reminder, no named reviewer.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_confirmation_completed
parameters.rationale: Instructions, running average and a clinician review task with a due date.

parameters.name: baseline.confirm_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Waits for the next routine visit.

parameters.name: with_loop.confirm_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: 7 days of readings plus review; service level is 14 days.

parameters.name: baseline.confirm_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Wide spread.

parameters.name: with_loop.confirm_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Narrower spread.

parameters.name: common.p_confirmed_raised
parameters.rationale: Some screening readings fall on re-measurement; same in both arms.

parameters.name: baseline.p_referral_sent
parameters.rationale: Referral depends on one clinician remembering.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_referral_sent
parameters.rationale: Task with owner and due date.

parameters.name: baseline.referral_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Routine.

parameters.name: with_loop.referral_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Service level is 3 days.

parameters.name: baseline.referral_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Wide spread.

parameters.name: with_loop.referral_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Narrower spread.

parameters.name: baseline.p_referral_accepted
parameters.rationale: Rejections are not followed up.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_referral_accepted
parameters.rationale: Rejected referrals go to a queue and are re-referred.

parameters.name: baseline.accept_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: No clock on the receiving clinician.

parameters.name: with_loop.accept_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Service level is 2 days.

parameters.name: baseline.accept_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Wide spread.

parameters.name: with_loop.accept_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Narrower spread.

parameters.name: baseline.p_appointment_booked
parameters.rationale: Patient must find and book alone.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_appointment_booked
parameters.rationale: Slots and cover shown before booking, coordinator follows up.

parameters.name: baseline.book_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Self-paced.

parameters.name: with_loop.book_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Service level is 5 days.

parameters.name: baseline.book_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Wide spread.

parameters.name: with_loop.book_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Narrower spread.

parameters.name: baseline.p_visit_attended
parameters.source: Simple app, Bangladesh: overdue lists and calls cut 3-month missed visits from 50% to 26% in six months (team brief)
parameters.rationale: Baseline 50% missed visits read as 50% attended. Different setting and programme; applied here to the first specialist visit as an approximation.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_visit_attended
parameters.source: Simple app, Bangladesh: overdue lists and calls cut 3-month missed visits from 50% to 26% in six months (team brief)
parameters.rationale: 26% missed visits read as 74% attended. Same caveat as the baseline value.

parameters.name: baseline.visit_wait_median_d
parameters.rationale: Time from booking to visit; longer without prioritisation.

parameters.name: with_loop.visit_wait_median_d
parameters.rationale: Slots offered by earliest availability.

parameters.name: baseline.visit_wait_sigma
parameters.rationale: Moderate spread.

parameters.name: with_loop.visit_wait_sigma
parameters.rationale: Moderate spread.

parameters.name: baseline.p_care_recorded
parameters.rationale: Outcome of the visit is recorded less reliably without a task.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_care_recorded
parameters.rationale: Visit outcome is the next step with an owner.

parameters.name: common.care_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Decision made at or just after the visit.

parameters.name: common.care_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Moderate spread.

parameters.name: common.p_treatment_started
parameters.rationale: Share of people in care who start treatment rather than surveillance.

parameters.name: baseline.p_closed
parameters.rationale: Closure is rarely recorded when nothing prompts it.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_closed
parameters.rationale: 4-week review task and ready-to-close list. Clinicians still decide.

parameters.name: baseline.close_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Slow.

parameters.name: with_loop.close_delay_median_d
parameters.rationale: Review at 28 days plus time to reach target.

parameters.name: common.close_delay_sigma
parameters.rationale: Wide spread.

parameters.name: with_loop.p_teach_back_first_pass
parameters.rationale: Share who answer the teach-back question correctly at the first try.

parameters.name: with_loop.confidence_probs_1_to_5
parameters.rationale: Self-rated confidence 1 to 5, centred slightly above the middle.

parameters.name: with_loop.severe_delay_multiplier
parameters.rationale: Severe results use shorter service levels in notification and acknowledgement.

parameters.name: with_loop.plan_p_done_by_size
parameters.rationale: Smaller steps are easier to complete.

parameters.name: with_loop.plan_p_partly_by_size
parameters.rationale: The rest of each week is missed.

parameters.name: with_loop.plan_p_accept_larger
parameters.rationale: After two done weeks the larger size is offered, never forced.

parameters.name: with_loop.plan_p_reengage_after_call
parameters.rationale: After three missed weeks a coordinator offers a call.

parameters.name: common.modifier_age_65_plus
parameters.rationale: Slightly lower odds of completing patient-driven steps for people aged 65 or over.

parameters.name: common.modifier_uninsured
parameters.rationale: Cost barrier on booking and attending for people with no insurance.

parameters.name: with_loop.modifier_uninsured_cover_shown
parameters.rationale: Showing cover before booking softens, but does not remove, the cost barrier.

parameters.name: common.modifier_yde_access
parameters.rationale: Fewer specialist slots in the Yaounde setting; applied to referral acceptance and booking.
